description: Evidence Priority taxonomy for the TransitOS Data Science & Engineering framework. Defines what must be resolved before each capability tier can be built. Applied per-line to determine CTM readiness.

priorities.label: CTM Bootstrap
priorities.description: Minimum evidence required to onboard a line into the Canonical Transit Model. No Journey Engine, no prediction, no simulation required.

attributes.description: Line ID, official name, operator, owner, color
Ordered list of stations with sequential position
Stations connecting to other lines or rail, with interchangeType
Year first opened to public (or null if not open)
Track gauge: STANDARD_1435mm, BROAD_1676mm, NARROW, etc.
At least one source document establishing the above P0 facts
WGS84 lat/lon for each station (blocks CTM if absent)

priorities.label: Journey Engine
priorities.description: Evidence required to run the Dijkstra/RAPTOR journey pathfinder and expose journey planning to passengers.

priorities.label: Prediction & Real-time
priorities.description: Evidence required for delay prediction, real-time arrival estimation, and coach recommendation.

attributes.description: Design or observed station dwell time

priorities.label: Advanced Intelligence
priorities.description: Evidence required for physics simulation, energy analytics, accessibility routing, indoor navigation.

attributes.description: Full emergency and service braking curve by speed
Energy recovery percentage or kWh/GTKM data
Motor type and rated power per axle

ctmReadinessRule: A line is CTM-ready when ALL P0 attributes have at least one evidence record with confidence ≥ 0.6 and temporalStatus ≠ PROPOSED (except where PROPOSED is the best available). The key P0 blocker is station_coordinates_wgs84.
sharedEvidenceRule: Evidence records that apply to multiple lines (e.g. Alstom Metropolis rolling stock spec shared by Lines 2A/2B/7) MUST be recorded ONCE in network/shared-evidence/ with applicableTo: [lineIds]. Per-line evidence directories should reference shared records via applicabilityRef rather than duplicate them.
duplicationPreventionRule: Never create separate D-rolling-stock-evidence.json files for Lines 2A, 2B, and 7 if they share the same rolling stock family. Use shared-evidence with applicabilityRef per line.
